subject: SmartDesk 5 stuck at lowest height
body: My SmartDesk 5 (order AN-284519) stopped moving yesterday. The controller shows E07 and the desk won't rise. I've tried unplugging it for a minute. I work from home and really need this fixed.
reply: Sorry about the E07 — that's the anti-collision sensor tripping, and there's a reset that clears it in most cases. Unplug the desk for a full 60 seconds, then hold the DOWN button for 10 seconds until the display flashes; the desk will settle to its base height and recalibrate. If E07 comes back after that, the controller box itself needs replacing — reply here and I'll ship one under warranty for order AN-284519, no return needed. You'll have it in 3-5 business days.

subject: Where is my order?
body: I ordered an ErgoChair Ultra two weeks ago, order AN-291003, and the tracking link hasn't updated since last Tuesday. Did it get lost?

I've asked the carrier for a trace and flagged it on our side. If there's no new scan within 48 hours, I'll ship a replacement immediately and you keep whichever arrives first. I'll email you either way by Thursday.

subject: ErgoChair posture dashboard shows no data
body: The pressure dashboard for my ErgoChair has been empty for three days. The app says 'sensor offline'. Chair is otherwise fine.
reply: Sensor offline for three days is almost always the seat module's battery having drained fully — it recharges from sitting time, but a long weekend away can flatten it. Sit for a normal workday and it should wake by end of day. If the dashboard is still empty tomorrow, go to Settings > Chair > Re-pair sensor; that fixes the rest of these cases. Still nothing after both? I'll send a replacement module under warranty — just reply here.

subject: WorkPod delivery window
body: Just ordered a WorkPod (AN-301226). The confirmation says freight delivery but no date. When will I actually get it, and do I need to prepare anything?
reply: Congrats on the WorkPod! For AN-301226: the freight team will call you within 5 business days to book a delivery window — typically 2-3 weeks out. Before it arrives, you'll want a level surface (pavers or a gravel pad both work; the guide is in your confirmation email) and a clear path at least 4 ft wide from street to site. Assembly is a weekend with two people; every fastener and tool ships in the crate. I'll stay on this thread until it's standing.

subject: Return request - desk too deep for my room
body: The SmartDesk Pro I bought (AN-297730) is great but it's 5cm too deep for my office nook. Can I return it? It's been 12 days.
reply: That's within our 30-day trial, so yes — full refund, no restocking fee. I've emailed you a prepaid freight label for AN-297730; keep the original box if you have it, otherwise any sturdy packaging works (the legs detach with the included hex key, reverse of step 4 in the guide). Refund lands 5-7 business days after the carrier scan. Sorry it didn't fit the nook — and if you want, the SmartDesk 5 is 8cm shallower; happy to apply the return toward one.

subject: Intern subscription question
body: I have the Intern on the $29 tier. If I upgrade mid-month to the $100 tier do I lose the rest of the month I already paid for?
reply: No — upgrades are prorated automatically. The unused portion of your $29 month is credited against the $100 tier the moment you switch, so you only ever pay for what you use. You can also downgrade the same way; nothing is lost either direction. Switch anytime from Account > Subscription, and the new limits apply within a minute.

subject: E12 on controller after moving apartments
body: Moved last week, reassembled my SmartDesk 5, now the controller shows E12 and nothing moves. Order AN-278114.
reply: E12 means the two legs lost sync — standard after a reassembly. Fix: unplug for 60 seconds, then press and hold DOWN until the desk fully lowers, clicks, and rises slightly (about 20 seconds). That re-syncs the motors and clears E12 in nearly every case. If a leg cable got pinched in the move it can recur — check both M8 connectors under the desktop are clicked in. Recurs anyway? Reply here and I'll swap the control box under warranty for AN-278114.

subject: Bulk order for office
body: We're outfitting a 14-person office. Do you do volume pricing on SmartDesk 5 + ErgoChair bundles, and can you invoice with NET-30?
reply: Yes to both. For 14 bundles you'd work with our team-orders desk: volume pricing starts at 10 units, NET-30 invoicing is standard for registered businesses, and delivery arrives palletized on your schedule rather than 14 separate boxes. I've cc'd team-orders with this thread — you'll get a quote within one business day. If you need chairs in mixed sizes or a couple of Pods in the mix, the same quote covers it.
